## Purpose
The `/api/runs` router: the run-history read/delete/export REST surface (relocated from `/api/workflows`) plus the newer revision-family, typed-artifact-lineage, and durable-event-replay endpoints. Every handler enforces per-user ownership so a cross-owner request resolves to 404, never a data leak.

## Shape
- `list_runs` / `get_run` / `delete_run` — CRUD over `WorkflowRun`, always filtered by `WorkflowRun.user_id == current_user.id`; `list_runs` uses a slim response schema (`WorkflowRunListResponse`) that excludes heavy `output`/`agent_outputs`/`input` columns for a ~50x smaller list payload.
- `export_pptx` — extracts PptxGenJS source from a stored agent output, raw `js_code`, or an HTML `<script>` block, then renders it to a `.pptx` download; sanitizes the filename against HTTP response splitting.
- `_compute_root_ids` / `_owned_family_members` — batched, cycle-guarded walks of the `parent_run_id` self-FK to compute each run's revision-family root and ordered member list, feeding `get_run_family` and `get_run_summary`.
- `_extract_chain_context` / `get_chain_context` — pulls pipeline-specific structured text (slide spec, backlog, prototype spec, etc.) out of a completed run's agent outputs to seed a chained pipeline's context.
- `get_run_artifacts` / `get_run_events` — Phase 5 typed-artifact lineage tree and durable `run_events` replay, both routed through the single `ScopedStore` (`agents/authz.py`) default-deny read path rather than a local query.
- `get_run_summary` — aggregates KPIs, a safe-projected per-agent breakdown, and the revision timeline into one response for the run-detail page.

## Why this shape
Every read repeats the same `user_id`-filtered query (or delegates to `ScopedStore`) rather than a shared decorator, because the module's own comments frame ownership-scoping as a per-query, IDOR-preventing discipline (missing/cross-owner → 404, never 403) carried over verbatim from the pre-relocation handlers.
